paired_prompt:
Video 1 is a real camera clip. Video 2 was generated from it by a model that should keep the same scene and camera motion but show it under this target condition: Overcast day after heavy rain: muddy brown water pools fill the ruts and low parts of the ground, mud splashes, wet dark soil and glistening vegetation; standing water reflects the sky; paved roads have shallow puddles and spray..
Compare them carefully. Return ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"structure_preserved": <1-5, same layout, terrain, objects, positions and camera motion>,
 "condition_achieved": <1-5, how convincingly Video 2 shows the target condition>,
 "semantic_consistency": <1-5, every object in Video 2 looks plausible under the target condition and nothing contradicts it>,
 "added_objects": ["<objects or structures in Video 2 that are not in Video 1>"],
 "contradictions": ["<things in Video 2 that contradict the target condition or physics>"],
 "summary": "<one sentence>"}
Use the full 1-5 range. Be specific and strict.
blind_prompt:
Watch this video clip carefully. Judge it as camera footage. Return ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"weather_and_light": "<short description of the weather, time of day and light you see>",
 "photorealism": <1-5, 5 = indistinguishable from real camera footage>,
 "physical_plausibility": <1-5, do light, shadows, water, snow, reflections, materials and objects behave as in reality>,
 "temporal_consistency": <1-5, 5 = objects and textures stay stable, 1 = heavy morphing, flicker or popping>,
 "overall": <1-5>,
 "implausible_elements": ["<each specific thing that does not make physical or semantic sense: floating or morphing objects, impossible light sources, objects that contradict the weather such as open umbrellas in a dry sunny scene, surfaces changing material, duplicated suns, smeared textures>"]}
Use the full 1-5 range. Be specific and strict.

blind.weather_and_light: Overcast, rainy day in a dense forest; diffused natural light with no direct sunlight; mist or fog visible in the distance; wet surfaces reflect ambient light.

added_objects: muddy brown water pools in ruts
paired.summary: Video 2 convincingly transforms Video 1 into an overcast, rain-soaked forest scene with muddy ruts, standing water, and glistening foliage, preserving all structural and motion elements while adding physically plausible wet conditions.
